# AKGLS Group

> AI-First Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Agency.

AKGLS Group is a premier search marketing and technical optimization agency specializing in high-performance organic SEO, core web vitals optimization, programmatic search scale, and direct citation targeting inside AI Search Platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity).

## Primary Services & Key Index

- [Home Page](https://akglsgroup.com/): Primary agency introductory overview, client performance dashboard simulator, global case-studies, and ROI estimation calculations.
- [SEO Services](https://akglsgroup.com/seo-services): Core search optimization framework covering ranking recovery, audience acquisition, and competitive domain positioning.
- [Technical SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/technical-seo): Server response modeling, headless client hydration tuning, XML schema graphs, indexation coverage audits, and duplicate path consolidations.
- [On-Page SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/on-page-seo): Heading hierarchies, vector semantical relevance scoring, keyword density optimization, and alt entity alignments.
- [Off-Page SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/off-page-seo-services): Secure, white-hat editorial link earning and high domain authority rating expansion.
- [Local SEO Services](https://akglsgroup.com/local-seo-services): Google Business Profile (GBP) optimizations, map-pack rankings, and hyper-localized physical citation builders.
- [Ecommerce SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/ecommerce-seo-services): Category page value structuring, schema markup injection, and Shopify/WordPress transaction mapping.
- [Enterprise SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/enterprise-seo-services): Large-scale crawling optimization, secure corporate site structure planning, and millions-of-pages ranking orchestration.
- [International SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/international-seo-services): Multilingual `hreflang` code configuration, regional directory maps, and geotargeting validations.
- [Mobile SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/mobile-seo-services): Core Web Vitals profiling, mobile-viewport responsive optimizations, and smartphone-first crawling compliance.
- [Programmatic SEO](https://akglsgroup.com/programmatic-seo-services): Large-scale automated template design, database-driven geographic modifier pages, and massive informational search footprint scaling.
- [Link Building](https://akglsgroup.com/link-building-services): Authoritative backlink acquisitions, citation asset development, and toxic link profile mitigations.
- [SEO Audit Services](https://akglsgroup.com/seo-audit-services): Crawl budget diagnostic suites, technical indexing checks, and gap analysis mapping.
- [SEO Consulting](https://akglsgroup.com/seo-consulting-services): Fractional SEO leadership, custom search strategy growth playbooks, and algorithmic penalty troubleshooting.

## Advanced AI Search Solutions

- [GEO Services](https://akglsgroup.com/geo-services): Generative Engine Optimization. Structuring content models to maximize retrieval priority in modern conversational query vectors.
- [AEO Services](https://akglsgroup.com/aeo-services): Answer Engine Optimization. Formatting semantic answer cards and concise schema properties to trigger direct summary panels on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Claude indices.
- [AI SEO Services](https://akglsgroup.com/ai-seo-services): Comprehensive programmatic content generation frameworks, AI audit workflows, and automated semantic analysis.

## Technical Specifications & Integration Guides

- **Technology Stack**: React 18+, Vite bundling system, Tailwind CSS v4 styling rules, and Express production static server.
- **Form Integrations**: Live Client Simulator tools and Request Proposals send payload structured data directly to internal audit pipelines.
- **Search Console Compliance**: Strict semantic HTML structure, JSON-LD Schema markup standardisation across all service types, and full metadata alignments.
